long_description:
India's most celebrated poet and storyteller Laksh Maheshwari (known as Single Handedly) brings his acclaimed show "Khushiyan" to the Lyric Stage Boston on November 1, 2026.

DATE: Sunday, November 1, 2026

TIME: 7:00 PM EST

LOCATION: Lyric Stage Boston, 140 Clarendon Street, Boston, MA 02116

LANGUAGE: Hindi

AGE: Strictly 10+

DURATION: 2 Hours (No Intermission)

TICKETS: $35 - $90 USD

"Khushiyan: A Journey to Find Joy" is a storytelling experience that explores one of the most fundamental questions of human life — what truly brings us happiness? Join Laksh Maheshwari for an evening filled with heartfelt stories, emotions that stay with you, and a gentle reminder of what khushiyan (joy) really means.

Laksh Maheshwari is recognized for blending humor with deep narratives, creating a soul-stirring journey filled with love, laughter, and human connection. He is also the author of The Descendants Trilogy and known for his engaging presence on Instagram as @single.handedly.

TIPS:

• Arrive early — seating is by ticket category (Platinum Meet & Greet available)

• Lyric Stage Boston is located in Boston's Back Bay, near public transit

• This is a storytelling show, strictly for ages 10 and up

Don't miss Laksh Maheshwari's Khushiyan live in Boston — one of the standout Hindi storytelling events coming to Massachusetts in 2026.
